faq.a: Iiyo, otjotjomahala, nu kapena okaundi, okulirisaerisa poo okunanena pehi. Matji ungura mouparanyene worungovi rongodji, otablete poo okombuyuta.

finish-the-saying.name: Mana otjiheve
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Yandjira ondjokoro: Oyo ya ondjokoro yomukwawo
finish-the-saying.description: Oviheve mbi tjiukwa nawa mbya hepa embo erikotokero, tjimuna "A penny saved is a penny ___". Kuma etooro poo raisa emano rwayo, ngono amu hungire ko.
finish-the-saying.short: Maneye oviheve mbi mwa yeva pamwe, ngono amu hungire ko.
finish-the-saying.intro: Oviheve vyonare oruvingi vi tjiukwa omuinyo auhe. Okakarata akehe ka raisa otjiheve tji tji tjiukwa nawa tji tja pumbwa embo ra koka pehi, omatoorero yetatu, nekonde ro "Raisa emano". Kombunda yemano, epuriro eporote mari nwine omahungi.
howTo: Leseye otjiheve pamwe nomundu mukwenyu noutukiriro.
Kuma embo ndi ma ri mana otjiheve, poo kuma "Raisa emano".
Leseye otjiheve atjihe rukwao nu amu hungire koutire wokukuma.
Kuma "Otjiheve tji ma tji landere" tji mwa rire nawa.
tips: Lesa nahuhu nu u tare oruvingi ngunda ohiyakurisa embo rokotokero. Ovingi ovandu ve ri tona ngunda o hinamane.
Omundu tji ma yandja emano peke, riyandjereye kuro. Omitango vyoviheve vimwe vi pongoroka pokati komapanga poo orukondwa.
Motjimbumba, omundu umwe ma lesa nu avehe mave hepa okuza pamwe kemano.

faq.q: Pe notjivareki tjomurungu poo ozombano?
faq.a: Kako. Kakuna oiri, outa, okubarura omikambo poo okutaura. Ove mo yenene okukatura moruveze aruhe, nu okutura pokati ondjira ombwa tjinene yokumanina.

faq.q: Indu tji twatoorora embo rarwe?
faq.a: Onyando mai raisa emaneno nga pa tjiukwa nu aihingi komurungu nomuhungiro. Kakuna outa, neziriro rarwe oro eri nawa.

faq.q: Oyo oyowala, nu mbi hepa okurisjanga?
faq.a: Ii, oyowala, nu kakuna okaungura, okurisjanga poo okutona kehi. Oyo i ungura mombapira yetanatero yointaneta kongodhi, otapleta poo okopiuta.

word-search.name: Okupaha omambo momasorondondo omanene
word-search.seoTitle: Okutsvaka ondjokoro nomatjatja anene, ina nokuprinta
word-search.description: Okutsvaka ondjokoro nomatjatja anene, ina, ovanene nozombanda. Ondjokoro ondjike, matjatja anene, nokuhanda momarongo ngaaro. Handa komutanda kapena printa.
word-search.short: Omasorondondo omanene, omambo omaṱiti, porweyo nokehi erike. Piritisa wina.
word-search.intro: Orukaze orutiṱi ndu nomasorondondo omanene nomambo omaṱiti uriri, aehe mayerwa porweyo poo nokehi. Nya eposiro etenga rembo, okuzambo unya eposiro rayo rokumanina. Mo vanga ombapira? Piritisa onyando ombe monyanyo imwe.
howTo: Toorora otjiungura nongaro yorukaze.
Tara komutanda womambo. Omambo mayerwa porweyo (kumoho kokuoko kokunene) poo nokehi (kombanda kuya kehi).
Nya eposiro etenga rembo, okuzambo unya eposiro rayo rokumanina.
Embo ndi maraara mariraisiwa nu aridikwamo momutanda.
Nya "Piritisa onyando indji" kutja u nyande kombapira nopeni poo opensela.
tips: Raisa embo momutanda nu mu pahe eposiro rarjo etenga pamwe.
Kombapira, openi yomara ohepu okukwata kombanda yopensela.
Hungireye komambo wotjiungura hi. Omambo womiti vyokurya ondjiro yombwa yokupatununa omazemburukiro wokutora, okuteleka poo komatara.

faq.q: Pena oiri poo outa?
faq.a: Kako. Kakuna oiri, outa, okubarura omikambo poo okutaura. Ove mo yenene okukatura moruveze aruhe, nu okutura pokati ondjira ombwa tjinene yokumanina.

faq.q: Mbi yenene okupiritisa okupaha kwomambo oku?
faq.a: Ii. Nya "Piritisa onyando indji" okupiritisa orukaze rwanambano momasorondondo omanene, nomutanda womambo kehi yaro. Onyando ombe aihe ya panguka.

faq.q: Oyo oyowala, nu mbi hepa okurisjanga?
faq.a: Ii, oyowala, nu kakuna okaungura, okurisjanga poo okutona kehi. Oyo i ungura mombapira yetanatero yointaneta kongodhi, otapleta poo okopiuta.

coloring.name: Omapandja wokurambika omara
coloring.seoTitle: Omapikiro okupaka okuhepa, ovanene, ina nongwendo
coloring.description: Omapandja omapu wokurambika omara wovakuru nge nomahina omanene: nya ovara, okuzambo unya otjisurande. Kakuna ondovazu, kakuna ovara ehavi, nepandja arihe ri piritwa owala.
coloring.short: Nya ovara, okuzambo unya orupa rwotjisurande. Piritisa omapandja wina.
coloring.intro: Omapandja nge nomitiro ovinene nu ovipepuke: ongono motee, ondjuwo, okakopi kotyee, ombapira nowato. Nya ovara, okuzambo unya orupa rwotjisurande okurizuzisa. Kakuna omara ehavi.
howTo: Toorora epandja.
Nya ovara. Ovara arihe rena ena rarjo ra sjangwapo.
Nya orupa rwotjisurande okurizuzisa novara mbo.
Rundurura ombango yoye moruveze aruhe mokuzuzisa rukwao.
Nya "Piritisa epandja ndi" okupeta epandja erirangata okurambika nopensela poo openi.
tips: Yandja omara yevari wokutoororapo komurungu yomara ayehe indu okutoorora tji maku munika auri ku tumba.
Omiti vyoviola nomatango wousorere oviwa uriri. Ihi otjokutara komanyando womara, kape nousemba wopoutende.
Omapandja nga piritwa yaungura nawa noopeni omazeu poo outende wokurambika, mbi hepu okukwata momake.

faq.q: Pena oiri poo outa?
faq.a: Kako. Kakuna oiri, outa, okubarura omikambo poo okutaura. Ove mo yenene okukatura moruveze aruhe, nu okutura pokati ondjira ombwa tjinene yokumanina.

faq.q: Omapandja nga owoutuku tjinene?
faq.a: Twa sura oviṋa ovihoze nu ovipepuke moruveze rwootjatji, kutja omapandja ye yane kovakuru. Omitiro ovinene vi tjita kutja okurambika omara ku kare ouhepu aahiri tjitwa otjoviṋa vyovanatje.

faq.q: Oyo oyowala, nu mbi hepa okurisjanga?
faq.a: Ii, oyowala, nu kakuna okaungura, okurisjanga poo okutona kehi. Oyo i ungura mombapira yetanatero yointaneta kongodhi, otapleta poo okopiuta.

conversation-cards.name: Outuha twomuhungiro
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Conversation Starters: Picture Cards for Families
conversation-cards.description: Picture cards with gentle conversation starters for families, friends and older adults, including people living with dementia. No quizzing, no right answers.
conversation-cards.short: Outuha twozisurande mbu nomapuriro omapatunuke nu ovihoze. Kakuna omarorero.
conversation-cards.intro: Kahuze kayehe kena otjisurande tji tjiukwa pamwe nombatero yokuhepa okuhungira, otja "Oombepo zaye nde ku ningira komutima?" Kakuna omayandjiro omasemba nu kakuna otjiṋa tji mo hepa okuzemburuka. Toorora otjiungura poo hanganisa aehe pamwe.
howTo: Toorora otjiungura, poo tura pu "Outuha aehe".
Lesa epuriro kombanda nu mu tare kotjisurande pamwe.
Zuva, handja ezuvire roye omuini, nu mu yandjere omuhungiro uhinge nawina.
Nya "Kahuze komurungu" tji wa ripurire, poo kara pamwe nokahuze kamwe oruveze ndu wa vanga.
Nya "Piritisa outuha aehe" okutenda orukondwa rwombapira.
tips: Zira epuriro ove omuini wina. Iri tjiukwa otjomuhungiro, aahi otjopuriro tyomatatere.
Konga ehungi, kape notjiṋa noviṋa viozondunge zotjili uriri. Oviṋa tji vya runduruka, iho otjiwa uriri.
Kahuze tji ka kutura otjiṋa tji tji nomuinyo omuzandu, yakura ombango ndjo nu mu hinge nawa kokahuze karwe.

faq.q: Ongwaye tji ku hina omapuriro nga "Mo zemburuka...?"
faq.a: Omapuriro nge rora omazemburukiro ye yenene okumunika aayo omarorero nu aye eta ohoni. Omapatununiro nga "Mbutira ohunga na..." ye yandjera omundu auhe okuhangana momuhungiro, kehi yomazemburukiro we.

faq.q: Mbi yenene okupiritisa outuha?
faq.a: Ii. "Piritisa outuha aehe" i piritisa otjiungura atjihe momasorondondo omanene, outuha ouvingi kepandja rimwe, aari ripurire okutendwa.

faq.q: Oyo oyowala, nu mbi hepa okurisjanga?
faq.a: Ii, otjo tjipereta tjimwe, nu kapena o-akhauti, omerisasaneno poo okutoora ko. Tji ungura momburausa yongongo mongodi, motablet poo mokompiuta.

photo-pairs.name: Oviperendero mbi patasana
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Ungura Otjinyando Tjokupatasana novi-oto vyOmbwaneno yOye
photo-pairs.h1: Oviperendero mbi Patasana: Patasisa ovi-oto vyOye Omuini
photo-pairs.description: Tjita ovi-oto vyombwaneno yoye omuini vi rire otjinyando omatjire tjokupatasana. Toorora ovi-oto 2 nga ku 6 motjirungura tjoye; vi kara momburausa yoye nu kavina pu vi tuminwa koutjiro.
photo-pairs.short: Toorora ovi-oto vyoye omuini nu vi patasise. Kapena tji tuminwa koutjiro.
photo-pairs.intro: Choose two to six of your own family photos from your phone, tablet or computer, and they become a matching game with large, visible pictures. The photos are shown only inside this page. They are not uploaded, saved or shared, and they disappear when you close the page. If you like, add a few words under each photo, and a gentle hint can point to one pair after a pause. This is a way of looking at family photos together.
howTo: Tap "Choose photos" and pick two to six photos.
Each photo appears twice. Tap one, then tap its pair.
If you like, add a few words under each photo. Captions are not saved.
Talk about each photo as you find it.
When you are done, close the page or tap "Clear photos". Nothing is kept.
tips: Toorora ovi-oto mbi munika nawa vyoviṋa vyosorote nombwaneno: okanamuinyo kombo, otjikunino, oruveze ndu hoza tjinene, poo eyuva lyokuhukisirwa.
Oviperendero vyomavaze noviṋa vi yenena okurira oupepu pu omarama wovandu, nu vi ekeza omuhingo wokutokomisa omundu okutumbula omana wovandu.
Essa ovi-oto vyovandu mba koka tji mape ya avi eta oruhoze rotjivarero, ngatu tji mo tjiwa nawa kutja vi eta omuhoko nombepo ombwaneno.

faq.q: Ovi-oto vyandje vi tuminwa pu rimwe koutjiro?
faq.a: Kako. Epandja rilesa ovi-oto mbi wa toorora motjirungura tjoye omuini nu vi raisa posikirini yoye. Kavi tuminwa ketwe poo komundu warwe auhe, nu vi pwa po indu tji wa pata poo okututa epandja rukwao.

faq.q: Pena o-iri yoruveze poo ombaro yomanaku?
faq.a: Kako. Kapena o-iri, ombaro, omatjindiriro poo okutaura. U yenena okupa oruveze aruhe ndu wa vanga, nu okupa pokati omuano omumbwa tjinene wokumanuka.

faq.q: Mbi yenena okutjangira otjinyando oruveze tji matji ya?
faq.a: Komburausa yako, otja tji tja ungurwa opo pahe ku ha tuurwa oviṋa vyoye vyouriri. Okambapira ka Creative Activities kokuha-futa ka iPhone na iPad ka yenena okutuura ovi-oto mbi wa toorora motjirungura tjoye.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo yoviperendero
picture-bingo.description: Free printable picture bingo for families, senior groups and care homes. Big pictures with words, 9 or 16 squares, and a large on-screen caller.
picture-bingo.short: Otukarta twobingo twoviperendero twokupurinda nomuraisire woposikirini onene yotjimbumba.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo yotjiposa novi-oto komurungu womano, opo ape ha kara omundu ngu ma lesa otutwiti. Purinda otukarta pekepeke, nu u ungurise omuraisire woposikirini okuraisa otji-oto atjihe tjinene po-TV, laptop poo tablet.
howTo: Toorora ozosikuere 9 poo 16 kokarta akehe na indu kutja penovanyande vengapi.
Twa omunwe pu "Purinda otukarta". Okarta akehe peke na kako.
Patulura omuraisire posikirini onene. Twa omunwe pu "Otji-oto tji tji landako" okuraisa otji-oto atjihe pamwe nena ratjo.
Ovanyande vasivisa otji-oto tji tji patasana kokarta kawo nosente, ombopi poo otjitwaye.
Auhe ngu ma urisa omukweyo, poo okarta akehe, u muna omarangariro. Kapena ovataure momuano mbwi: kayende komurungu nokunyanda nganduu auhe a kare nomukweyo.
tips: Ungurisa ovitwaye ovinene tjimuna outji wokunyandisa poo ovikupiko vyozondjupa. Ombopi ozotwiti mazi yenene okutinda okutoora.
Tumbula ena rotjiperendero nu u hungire tjimwe kombinga yatjo: "Owoato yomeva. Ouṋi ngwa kondere mo-woato?"
Hakarisa ovandu mbe nomatendo wokumuna popezi nosikirini, nu u kute ovavatere pamwe novanyande mbe hepa ombatero.
Ozosikuere omuvyu ozingi rotjimbumba otjiingi. Kara noruveze rwominute 20 nga ku 30 uriri.

faq.q: Mbi tjiti vi bingo yoviperendero monganda yomatjeverero?
faq.a: Purinda okarta kamwe komunyande auhe, tura omuraisire posikirini onene ndji u na yo, nu u isane oviperendero katiti katiti, amutumbula ena ra tjihe. Nyandei nganduu auhe a mune omukweyo, opo ape ha siwa omundu kombunda.

faq.q: Okatjipereta okupurinda?
faq.a: Ii. Purinda otukarta otuingi otja tji mo hepa, oruveze aruhe ndu wa vanga, kombwaneno yoye omuini poo yotjimbumba.

faq.q: Ovandu mave yenena okunyanda nokuhina okulesa?
faq.a: Ii. Osikuere aihe otjiperendero otjinene, pamwe nena ratjo kehi ya tjo kwoowo mbe vanga omambo.

picnic-planner.name: Picnic planner
picnic-planner.seoTitle: Picnic Planner: Choose Pictures for an Outing
picnic-planner.h1: Picnic Planner: Choose Pictures, Then Match Them
picnic-planner.description: Choose food and things-to-do pictures for a picnic, then play a gentle matching round with them. Nothing is timed. Free to play and print.
picnic-planner.short: Pick food and outing pictures for a picnic, then match them.
picnic-planner.players: Solo, or 2 people side by side
picnic-planner.intro: Tap pictures of food and things to do to put them in a picnic basket, which holds up to six. A sentence in words says what is in the basket, such as "Our picnic: bread, cheese, apples and a kite." Then tap "Let's play with our picnic" for a gentle matching round made from the chosen pictures. The pictures stay showing, and nothing is timed, scored or saved. "Print our picnic list" prints a checklist of what you chose, with a tick box for each thing to pack.
howTo: Tap a picture of food or something to do. It goes into the basket.
Tap a picture in the basket to take it out again.
Choose at least two things, then tap "Let's play with our picnic".
Tap two pictures that are the same. The pictures stay showing, so there is nothing to remember.
Tap "Print our picnic list" for a paper checklist to take with you.
tips: Ask the people you are with what they would like to bring, and choose the pictures together.
Talk about each picture as it goes in: "Do you remember the kite we flew at the beach?"
On paper, the blank lines are for anything else you want to bring, or for a name.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed or counted, and nobody wins. The matching round has no misses and no points.

faq.q: Is this a meal plan?
faq.a: No. It is a picture plan for an outing, to talk about and to take on paper. It does not say what anyone should eat.

faq.q: Are the pictures we choose saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The basket stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or sent, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print our picnic list" prints one page, on A4 or US Letter. It shows the pictures you chose with a tick box for each, and blank lines for anything else.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

scrapbook.name: Scrapbook
scrapbook.seoTitle: Scrapbook: Turn Family Photos Together, Page by Page
scrapbook.h1: Scrapbook: Add Your Photos and Captions, Then Turn the Pages
scrapbook.description: Choose two to twelve of your own family photos on your device and turn them as a book, with a few words under each. Nothing is uploaded. Free to print.
scrapbook.short: Page through your own family photos together, like a book.
scrapbook.players: Solo, or 2 people side by side
scrapbook.intro: Choose two to twelve of your own photos from this device. Each photo becomes one page of a book, large enough to see, with an optional few words under it. Turn the pages with the buttons or the arrow keys, and use "Look together" to sit side by side with just the photos and words. Your photos stay on this device. They are not uploaded or saved, and the book is gone when you close the page. "Print the scrapbook" prints one photo and its words on each page, with page numbers.
howTo: Tap "Choose photos" and pick two to twelve photos. Ask before using a photo of someone who cannot say yes.
Turn the pages with "Previous page" and "Next page", or with the Left and Right arrow keys.
Add a few words under a photo if you like. Use "Move earlier" or "Move later" to change the order.
Tap "Look together" to hide the editing controls and look at the book side by side.
Tap "Print the scrapbook" for a paper copy, or "Clear the book" when you are done. Nothing is kept.
tips: Hurura ofoto dovintu ovi tjiwa, ngaashi ogarten, ozohombo nondyuo ye tjiwa. Pepa ondjembo ovipe, u-tjongorokere kombinga yomufoto nomufoto.
Pa ovandu ovipe ondjovi imwe nombinga yomufoto mumwe, nangwi ondjovi imwe, u-nyore ondjovi nngwa ngaashi va i-tjiwa.
Pondjembo ovipe, ondjembo yomifoto ye yi nokuhepa nawa mo kuhwepo kwomukuru, nomakuru ngwa nokuwapa ofoto dawo nomaonganganeno kombinga yayo.

faq.q: Kuna ehumbo, ozonombinga nomuwinda?
faq.a: Kakuna. Kakuna ehumbo, kakuna ozonombinga nokupewa, nomuntu kakwa-wina. Enamba yomufoto ota tjiwa ngaashi mu-tjiwa mo ondjembo.

faq.q: Ofoto detu nomaonganganeno gawo oga-kuka, oga-tumwa, nangwi oga-nyokwa?
faq.a: Kakuna. Ofoto oya-tanwa kuno tjinene ngoye kongwe, kaya-tumwa, kaya-kukwa, nangwi kaya-nyokwa kohi. Omaonganganeno ga-kuka ngoye ondjovi ndi i-kwashe nokukala ondjembo ya-kwata. Ondjembo i-na-wuka.

faq.q: Otu ngwenda okupirinta ondjembo?
faq.a: Ee. “Pirinta ondjembo yomifoto” ota pirinta ofoto imwe nomaonganganeno gayo mo ndjembo imwe nenamba yomufoto. Pehe A4 nangwi US Letter mo ngwe nokupirinta.

faq.q: Ohuna okutamba, nondi ngwa kufa okunyora?
faq.a: Ee, ohuna, nokuhinda kuna akaunti, kakuna okunyora nangwi okutuka. Oho-kwanyenenwa mo webu mefonu, mo tabuleti nangwi mo komputa.

collage-board.name: Ondjuo yokuhimbira ofoto
collage-board.seoTitle: Ondjuo yokuhimbira ofoto: Ovandu 2 ohava hange ofoto nokuzuvarisa
collage-board.h1: Ondjuo yokuhimbira ofoto: Hange ofoto mondjuo imwe nokuzuvarisa
collage-board.description: Ovandu 2 ohava hange ofoto dokuhimba mondjuo imwe yokukondoma nokuzuvarisa. Pa ofoto, u-yandje nomo pomupaka. Kakuna ehumbo nangwi ozonombinga. Ohuna okutamba nokupirinta.
collage-board.short: Hange ofoto mondjuo imwe yokukondoma nokuzuvarisa.
collage-board.players: Ovandu 2, ovo ta kara ko ngoye
collage-board.intro: Ovandu 2 ohava kara ko ngoye, nondjuo imwe ine mapaka 12 nondjuo ya mo ofoto 8 zokukondoma. Pa ofoto imwe, u-yandje nomo pomupaka, ofoto ohai ya ko. Omuntu omwe ohe-tuka okuzuvarisa. Ofoto dombada dimwe nedimwe dina ondyuo yayo, ondjovi nangwi ekwamba, ngaashi ondjuo nangwi edhina, nondyo ondjuo i-na-monena omuntu a hange ofoto nani, kakuna okuyambo nomavara. Omuntu omwe ohe-tuka okupa, nondjovi imwe ohai hindu nokuhinda. Kakuna ehumbo, kakuna ozonombinga, kakuna okuwika. “Pirinta ondjuo” ota pirinta ondjuo ine mapaka nofoto dokukondoma.
howTo: Pa ofoto mondjuo yokuhimba. Ota tjiwa “Ohayi hurura” ngaashi ohai hurura.
Pa papaka iri ondjuo. Ofoto oya ya ko, nondjovi yomuntu ota zuvarisa.
Omuntu omwe nangwi womuhe ohe-tuka okupa nangwi “Tura ofoto yomuzuva” okuhindura ondjovi imwe.
Pa “Ofoto dimwe dopoka” okuzumbulukatekera ondjuo ye ndji. Ofoto ndi ya ko kale ohai kala ko.
Pa “Tangerera pokutanga” okurura ondjuo, nomo “Kohi” ngwa ohu-kuhinda.
tips: Tjongorokera edhina lyofoto ngaashi ya ya ko, ngaashi “ekapu ya tiye ya ya kombinga yondjuo”. Okutjongorokera ohu-yambo okukara kouhandu.
Pa ovandu ovari 2 ngwa ohava zuvarisa ofoto nondyuo, opo omuntu yomwe nomuhe a kale nomaweo.
Pondjembo, tanga ofoto 8 nomukuru ta yamba, nokuyandja pamapaka yakupirintwa.

faq.q: Kuna ehumbo, ozonombinga nomuwinda?
faq.a: Kakuna. Kakuna ehumbo, kakuna ozonombinga nokupewa, nomuntu kakwa-wina. Ondjuo ine ofoto mo papaka imwe nedimwe ohai ya ondjuo yuulye.

faq.q: Ofoto dotu hange ngoye oga-kwashwa nangwi oga-tumwa?
faq.a: Kakuna. Ondjuo ya kala ko tjinene pondjuo ye yi. Kaya-kwashwa, kaya-tumwa, nangwi kaya-werwa. Ya kakala ngoye ondjuo yapewa nokuhinda eyuva.

faq.q: Tu-ta kunyonga ofoto dounene?
faq.a: Omuntu komwe nomuhe ina ondyuo ye. Ofoto domuntu wotete dina ekwamba mo ekuku, nodofoto domuntu wowiri dina ondjovi mo ndjovi, nomadhina gawo ga ri ondjuo koikaho.

faq.q: Pana ondjuo yomupuku?
faq.a: Ee. “Pirinta ondjuo” ota pirinta ondjuo ine mapaka 12 nofoto 8 mondjuo imwe ine ondjurua yimwe, nomutanga wokukondoma. Omukuru ota kondoma.

faq.q: Ohuna okutamba, nondi ngwa kufa okunyora?
faq.a: Ee, ohuna, nokuhinda kuna akaunti, kakuna okunyora nangwi okutuka. Oho-kwanyenenwa mo webu mefonu, mo tabuleti nangwi mo komputa.

garden-planner.name: Omupango wegarten
garden-planner.seoTitle: Omupango wegarten: Pange ondjuo yomukunda nokufuma ofoto dokumwe
garden-planner.h1: Omupango wegarten: Hurura ofoto nokupanga ondjuo
garden-planner.description: Hurura ofoto dozombanda nezindu zegarten, nopange mo mapaka 12 yondjuo. Pa ofoto, nopa papaka. Kakuna ehumbo nangwi ozonombinga. Ohuna okutamba nokupirinta.
garden-planner.short: Hurura ofoto dozombanda nopange ondjuo ine mapaka 12.
garden-planner.players: Omuntu omwe, nangwi ovandu 2 ovo ta kara ko ngoye
garden-planner.intro: Hurura ofoto mondjuo yozombanda nezindu zegarten, nopa papaka opo u-yandje ofoto imwe nimwe. Ondjuo ine mapaka 12, nepaka limwe ota kwata ofoto imwe. Ekwamba mo tjiyo ota ti, ngaashi “Omupango wenu una 3 ozoizuva, 2 ozoroses na 1 omuti.” Kakuna ehumbo, kakuna ozonombinga, nokakuna okusuvanwa, nokakuna omahuru. Ondjovi ei ohai yi okutjongorokera, kaiye ouyambi wokulima. “Pirinta omupango” ota pirinta mapaka nofoto dowa hurura, nomapaka mapwiri okujanduka nomakunga okunyora.
howTo: Pa ofoto mondjuo yokuhimba. Ota tjiwa “Ohayi hurura” ngaashi ohai hurura.
Pa papaka. Ofoto oya ya ko, nondjovi ota zuvarisa.
Opo u-tjange papaka, hurura ofoto imwe nopa papaka. Opo u-pumbure papaka, u-pe papaka ofoto kakuna ohu-hurura.
Pa “Tangerera pokutanga” opo u-tuwe mapaka ngoye, nomo “Kohi” ngwa ohu-kuhinda.
Pa “Pirinta omupango” opo u-kale nekopi yomupango nokufuma ngoye.
tips: Talk about each picture as it goes in, such as "the sunflower goes by the birdhouse". Talking makes it a shared activity.
Let each person choose a picture in turn, or choose the pictures together, so both have a say in the plot.
On paper, the blank beds are for drawing in your own ideas, and the notes lines are for anything you want to remember.

faq.q: Is this planting advice?
faq.a: No. This is a picture plan to talk about, not planting advice. It does not say when, where or how to plant anything, because that depends on where you live.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored, rated or counted, and nobody wins. A full plot gets no special message.

faq.q: Are the pictures we choose saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The plan stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print the plan" prints one page, on A4 or US Letter. It shows the twelve beds with the pictures you chose, the summary in words, and blank lines for notes.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

coloring-wall.name: Group coloring wall
coloring-wall.seoTitle: Group Coloring Wall: One Picture for Many Hands
coloring-wall.h1: Group Coloring Wall: One Big Picture, Colored Together
coloring-wall.description: Print one large picture across several pages, so a family, a class or a care home can color one wall together. Free to print. No timer or score.
coloring-wall.short: Print one big picture across pages for many people to color.
coloring-wall.players: A group, at a table or on a wall
coloring-wall.intro: Choose a picture from the coloring pages and a wall of 4, 6 or 9 pages. Print the wall: the first page shows how to put it together, and each of the other pages is one part of the same big picture, with a label such as A1 in its corner. Each person colors one or more pages, in any colors and any style. The pages are then laid out by their labels and joined with tape on the back. Nothing is timed, scored or saved.
howTo: Choose a picture, then choose how many pages the wall has.
Read the map on the screen, which shows where each label goes.
Tap "Print the wall" and print all the pages.
Give each person one or more pages to color. Colors and styles do not need to match.
Lay the pages out by their labels, and join them with tape on the back.
tips: Give the pages with the simplest outlines to the people who want a quieter task, and the busier ones to anyone who enjoys them.
Hang the wall where everyone can see it, and talk about the parts together.
Choose a smaller wall for a small table, and a bigger one for a room.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or counted, and nobody wins. The wall is simply a picture that many people colored.

faq.q: Are the pages saved or sent anywhere?
faq.a: No. The wall is made on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Do the colors have to match?
faq.a: No. Every person can use any colors and any style. The pages still join up into one picture.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. The printed wall is the whole game: a first page with the steps and a map, and one page for each part of the picture.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

quiet-shapes.name: Quiet shapes puzzle
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Quiet Shapes Puzzle: Fit Shapes Into a Picture
quiet-shapes.h1: Quiet Shapes Puzzle: Fit the Pieces into the Picture
quiet-shapes.description: Fit simple shapes into the outline of a house, a boat, a fish and more. Tap a piece, then a space of the same shape. There is no timer or score. Free to play and print.
quiet-shapes.short: Fit simple shapes into a picture, at your own pace.
quiet-shapes.intro: A picture outline, such as a house, a boat or a rocket, is divided into spaces. Each space has a piece of the same shape, a large or small triangle, a square, a parallelogram or a rectangle. Tap a piece, then tap a space of the same shape, and it fits. The space turns the piece for you, so there is nothing to drag or rotate. If a piece is a different shape from a space, it stays in the tray with a short note. Nothing is timed or scored, and nothing is saved or sent. "Print this shape" prints the outline and its pieces on one page to color or cut out.
howTo: Tap a piece in the tray. It shows "Chosen" while it is selected.
Tap a space in the picture. If the shape matches, the piece fits there.
If it does not match, try another space. Nothing is lost by trying.
Tap a piece in the picture to take it back to the tray, or use "Start again" to take all of them back.
When every space has its piece, the picture is complete. Tap "Another shape" for a new one, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Tjitira omirongo yokutjiurisa kuti mu mone ondjuo imwe nomwe. Mu tjiure omirongo, mu kale nomatjiri ngaa omirongo ihi tjiwa, nawa ndi ye ya tjiwa ondjuo yomuvanguro fye.
Tanga nomatjiri manene, ngashi “otriangle” nomaviereka manene. Omatjiri mandjiki ngoo ohaa ya kuhika ko okutanga.
Yetja omatjiri nomutwe nomaupuka ngaa mu ende: “otriangle, ongwe, oviereka vanene.” Okuyeta po kuna okuyambura ko kuna okurikwa pamwe.
Pamapapiro, mu kuruura omatjiri nomavara 2 nomavara 3, nangwe mu kutekuta nomukuru ngaa a yambe.

faq.q: Ko kuna etjaho, ontanga ye omiti gomapunda?
faq.a: Kaha. Hakuna etjaho, ohaa tala omiti kuhi, nohaa rongwa mapunda. Eshi tjitjiri tji ka ya kuhika mo, tji ka pitwa ko, nomu nawa mu hepe ngapi mu nakupe.

faq.q: Oshi tjitjiri tjehi tu tjitira otji tu hungirwa nangwe tu tumwa?
faq.a: Kaha. Ondjuo ya tjitirwa ki tji kala peni fye pokuna ei. Kayi hungirwa, kayi tumwa nangwe kayi tanwa, nayo i kwata po eshi mu pandja ekuvo.

faq.q: Ovipaka ovi mbi, ngaa ozo tjiva ngaa okunyanya ovi pe pepi, ovi mbi ya kunene?
faq.a: Ondjuo yomukuru yi tjitirwa yi kunene nokuvanga ko kwa kwata ekuvo, nomutjiri mumwe nomumwe owo ondjuo yoku pindjirwa nomunwe nangwe nokutjandjiko ka Tab. Omatjiri mouvi womutjiri ye ya tjiva nomaupuka manene ekuvo.

faq.q: Kuna ondjuo yo kopapiro?
faq.a: Eyo. “Print this shape” otji tji tjitira ondjuo imwe kopapiro imwe: ondjuo nomaomirongo yayo ya kutjiurisa, nomatjiri ta tjitirwa ko yo ndjapo. Mu kuruure omatjiri, nangwe mu a kutaure ngaa ya kuhika. Mukuru ngaa a kutaure kuti a yambe.

faq.q: Ko kuna mbe, ovi ndi yandja etjaho?
faq.a: Eyo, kuna mbe, nekuvo ka kuna akaunte, kuyandja nangwe kukakura. Ota shandjwa mo mu browser yewebsaiti mo fonu, tablet nangwe komputa.

calm-breathing.name: Omusuwiro wombepo ombwaneno
calm-breathing.description: Oruveze rwomusuwiro ombwaneno nowakwi wokuhanewa: orungoneno orwongundiparise ru kura nu aru teka momisuwiro ihamuhawe. Ove u tji uta, nu u yenena okupa oruveze aruhe.
calm-breathing.short: Orungoneno orwongundiparise rwokusuvira pamwe natjo. Uta nu u pe oruveze ndu wa vanga.
calm-breathing.intro: Pena oruveze pu tji ri nawa okusuva katiti mwakwi. Twa omunwe pu "Uta", okuzambo hita nomuinyo indu orungoneno tji maru kuru nu u pise omupo indu tji maru teka. Toorora omusuwiro womangovindo poo wouparise. Ka muti wonduriro, omuhingo wombepo yomuhoko wokuhanewa uriri.
howTo: Kuramei nawa noutjire oruvingo noruvingo.
Toorora omusuwiro: womangovindo poo wouparise.
Twa omunwe pu "Uta". Hita nomuinyo indu orungoneno tji maru kuru, nu u pise indu tji maru teka.
Tji ripa owini kombunda yomisuwiro ihamuhawe, poo u twe omunwe pu "Peka" oruveze aruhe ndu wa vanga.
tips: Kwatei komaoko poo u ture eke keoko romundu ngu u tjevera tji tji ri nawa ku ye.
O kakondjisa. Tji mave vanga okutara uriri, otjo tji ri nawa.
Tji pe nomundu ngu nomizeze momusuwiro, nga suve oukukutu nu a tare korungoneno uriri. Pura kondjita kombinga yomizeze ayohe yomusuwiro.

faq.q: Ihi otjinyando tjounganga tjomusuwiro?
faq.a: Kako. Oruveze oruhape uriri rwombepo nomuhoko. Keri epango romuinyo omuserekarise poo omutjise auhe. Hungira nondjita kombinga yozongendo zourumbu woye.

faq.q: Orungoneno maru rinyanga aapo ami hima uta?
faq.a: Kako. Kakuna tji matji nyinganyinga nga tji wa tona Start, nu matji kurama kombunda yomahihero hamboumwe poo tji wa tona Stop. Tji ebe otjiungurisiwa tjoye tja terekwa okututura omahenyo, omambo maye runduruka aapo otjimbulungundu katji kurire ko.

faq.q: Hapo otjotjali, nu mbi hepa okuritjangisa?
faq.a: Ii, otjotjali, nu kakuna okaawundi, okuritjangisa poo okunanena mo. Matji ungura mombrowser yoweve mongodji, motablet poo mokompiyuta.

story-chain.name: Ondjo yozonkango
story-chain.seoTitle: Ondjo yozonkango: Etjaho Lokurikwa Lyozondjuo Pamwe
story-chain.h1: Ondjo yozonkango: Yeta Ondando Ondjuo Imwe Nomwe
story-chain.description: Omutjiri gwondjuo gu kura omwe nomwe, nomundu nomundu a yeta esentensi imwe pondjuo, nokuyeta nomaupuka. Hakuna okunyora, hakuna eyaruro lyokuyanduka. Mahala, nokukoromeka, hakuna etimer nangwe ontanga.
story-chain.short: Pandja ondjuo imwe, ngoo mundu nomundu a yete esentensi imwe, mu tjiurisa.
story-chain.intro: Etjaho otja tanga nondjuo imwe, nondjo yozonkango ya kura omwe nomwe. Mundu nomundu a yeta esentensi imwe pondjo ei ya tjiri ko, nokuyeta nomaupuka, mu tjiurisa. Esentensi ya ka kumanena ko ondjuo yokutjiva, nangwe ko etjitjiro, nangwe okuyeta eyaruro lyokunyanya. Hakuna okunyora, hakuna okurekorda, hakuna eyaruro lyo kupuka, nomundu u na otjirongo tjokurekera ngoo. Ondo yo kuhika kondjuo 8, ngoo mu nga okutanga ondjo ndjuo.
howTo: Mu tale ondjuo yomuvanguro pamwe.
Mu tjiurisa: mundu nomundu a yete esentensi imwe pondo yozonkango ya tjiri ko. Mundu wa kuhika a rekere.
Pindja “Add a picture” okuhinga ondjuo yokutanga pe pe nozonkango.
Pindja “Take the last one off” ngaa mu kahake okuya kondjuo ya tjiri ko.
Ngeshi ozonkango ni nondjuo 8, pindja “Start a new chain” ngaa mu tanga ondjo yokutanga, nangwe mu kwate.
tips: Esentensi enini ihi tjiwa: “Omundu o fundumba omaasi.” Mundu wa kuhika oha ka yandja, nangwe oha rekera.
Ondjuo i yandjise otjitjiro. Kuna ohi na etjiwa lyokuyandja kuhi.
Kwata eshi nomu nawa. Okukwata pakati ohi kuhimbo yehi nyanga yo kuhika nawa.

faq.q: Kuna etimer nangwe ontanga?
faq.a: Kaha. Hakuna eiyo, hakuna ontanga, hakuna omiti gokukara, nangwe okutambuka. Mu kwate nawa eshi, nokukwata pakati ohi kuhimbo yehi nyanga yo kuhika nawa.

faq.q: Hakukarwa nangwe hakunyorwa?
faq.a: Kaha. Esentensi tayi yetwa nomaupuka, kayi nyorwa, kayi rekordwa nangwe kayi tumwa kuhi. Ekuvo ola lyeta ondjuo fye.

faq.q: Ovanga omundu a kana okuyeta chinji?
faq.a: Mundu wa kuhika a rekere, nomundu wa tjiri a yandje. Hakuna a tji tomo okutaura nangwe okurikanena ondjuo.

faq.q: Ko kuna mbe, ovi ndi yandja etjaho?
faq.a: Eyo, kuna mbe, nekuvo ka kuna akaunte, kuyandja nangwe kukakura. Ota shandjwa mo mu browser yewebsaiti mo fonu, tablet nangwe komputa.

quiet-scene.name: Ondjuo yokukoromeka
quiet-scene.h1: Ondjuo Yokukoromeka: Ondjuo Imwe Nomwe Yokuhuka Ko
quiet-scene.description: Ondjuo imwe nomwe enene, yokukoromeka, ya kuyo omutjitjiro mupuka. Pindja Next nangwe Previous ngoo mu kara nawa. Hakuna chinji chi tjiyuka nangwe chi tjintu kongaa, nohaa ko etimer nangwe ontanga. Mahala, nokuhepa akaunte.
quiet-scene.short: Tala ondjuo imwe yokukoromeka nomwe, nowoye omuhiko.
quiet-scene.players: Ove ponene, nangwe ovanji mondjuwo imwe
quiet-scene.intro: Ondjuo imwe enene itjiva ekuvo, nomutjitjiro mupuka pevi. Pindja “Next picture” nangwe “Previous picture” ngoo mu kara nawa okuhinga ondjuo ya tjiri. Hakuna chinji chi tjiyuka, chi kwakwa nangwe chi tjintu kongaa, nohaa rongwa mapunda. Pindja “Bigger picture” ngaa ondjuo fye i tjitwe, ovanthu vaswe ve i mone ko ontelevishen.
howTo: Mu tale ondjuo pamwe.
Yeta omutjitjiro mupuka po ngaa mu kwata.
Pindja “Next picture” nangwe “Previous picture” ngoo mu kara nawa.
Pindja “Bigger picture” ngaa ondjuo fye i tjitwe, nowa “Show everything” ngaa ouvi wa kuhika u vaqtiwe.
Kwata eshi nawa nokupindja “Done for now”.
tips: Mu pe omundu ouhamba wokuhinga ondjuo ya tjiri: mu rindje a tale, pastu mu pindje Next.
Ovanji mu pamwe, mu kuruure “Bigger picture” ko ontelevishen nangwe kosikirini kunene, mu tuwe kohi vaswe ve i mone.
Kuna ondjira yokutala ondjuo ihi nayo nawa kaha. Okutaura pondjuo, fye ko, ondjo yokuyambura nawa.

faq.q: Kuna etimer nangwe ontanga?
faq.a: Kaha. Hakuna eiyo, hakuna ontanga, hakuna omiti gokukara, nangwe okutambuka. Mu kwate nawa eshi, nokukwata pakati ohi kuhimbo yehi nyanga yo kuhika nawa.

faq.q: Ohi tjiyeta nangwe ohi tjiyuka?
faq.a: Kaha. Hakuna ekaka, hakuna chinji chi tjiyuka, chi kwakwa nangwe chi tjintu kongaa. Ondjuo i tjiyuka fye eshi mu pindja otjipindjiro.

faq.q: Kuna ehunga rapapa?
faq.a: Aihi. Ohi ondjuwo yokumona pamwe pa screen. Foto nenge kaate yomutima ku ya nokuyandja pameza yi na ondjuwo ihe nkwao.

faq.q: Ondjuwo ihe kohoro, nomutji oku na okukwatwa ko?
faq.a: Ee, ondjuwo kohoro, kahi na akaunti, kahi na okukwatwa ko nenge okuhepera. Ohi tjiuka mo web browser pa phone, tablet nenge computer.

color-wash.name: Okupaka ombara
color-wash.seoTitle: Color Wash: Ombara ihe yokuhenenena pokati kouhapo pa lepapa
color-wash.h1: Color Wash: Paka ombara ihe yokuhenenena pokati kouhapo pa lepapa
color-wash.description: Brush ihe yokuhenenena ihe paka ombara ihe-hepera nokupitikira pa lepapa limwe, nombara ine nomaburasi ayarui. Kahi na ekaro, kahi na ekwatwa nenge ondjuwo. Ohi tjiuka kohoro, kahi na akaunti.
color-wash.short: Paka ombara ihe yokuhenenena pa lepapa, nokuhenenena kove.
color-wash.players: Owe nowe, nenge ovanthu 2 ovahinda pamwe
color-wash.intro: Lepapa limwe nebrush limwe ihe yokuhenenena. Kotera ombara nobrush, owe ogu drag pa lepapa okupaka ombara. Lepapa kahi na ekaro: kahi na ekwatwa, kahi na ndjuwo yokuhepera nenge ekwatero. Paka ombara kuhinga ko ombwa, nenge tara brush opo mutumba. Lepapa ondjuwo ihe rapapa ihe ya kaungurura konke, na "Put it back" ihe ya kuhepeka ombara.
howTo: Kotera ombara. Ombara ine ina ina rayo.
Kotera “Wide” nenge “Very wide”. “Very wide” ihe yokupaka lepapa tuu nomutumba umwe.
Drag pa lepapa nomunwe, mouse nenge pen okupaka ombara.
Nenge tjiuka ombwa dya arrow okutungurura ring ya brush, na Space okukona brush nenge okuhiyamo.
Pindja “A fresh page” okukaungurura lepapa, na “Put it back” ngu owa hepa ombara.
tips: Leka omuntu wa tuu okotere ombara yomutumba ngu, na kuungura nomukwatwa ombara ngu ya tokwa.
“Very wide” nayo ihe yokukoka nomaoko ana kutentima, sigo brush kahi na okuvara nawa.
Kahi na ndjira ihe ihe yokupaka nawa. Tara nonkango ngu owa hala, nenge pindja “Done for now”.

faq.q: Kuna ekaro, ekwatero nenge ondjuwo?
faq.a: Aihi. Lepapa kahi na ekaro. Kahi na ekwatwa, ehuvi, ekwatero nenge ekaratero, nomalaka kahi na okuyandja ondjuwo yokukwata ehuka.

faq.q: Lepapa rihi kutwara nenge kutumwa?
faq.a: Aihi. Kahi na ihe ikutwarwa, ikuprintwa nenge ikutumwa kohi. Ombara oyi kara pa lepapa eli kuna okuhoka.

faq.q: Ndi nahi okukoka ko mouse nenge touch screen?
faq.a: Ee. Lepapa ha kara no focus, arrow keys oyi tjiuka ring ya brush, na Space oyi kona brush nenge okuhiyamo. Screen oyi ti "Brush down" nenge "Brush up" zo ngoyo.

faq.q: Kuna ehunga rapapa?
faq.a: Aihi. Watercolor pa lepapa ina ondjuwo imwe, brush ine mbiri nombara imwe nawa, ngaho otai ka hepera nomutumba ngu pameza.

faq.q: Ombara ihe ndi?
faq.a: Yellow, orange, green nenge purple, ombara ine ina ondjuwo dyoye zonde dyo picture games. Ombara imwe yomuna ina rayo yo mahinga, na ina yi ngo ya tuka pokati kohaatjiuka.

faq.q: Ondjuwo ihe kohoro, nomutji oku na okukwatwa ko?
faq.a: Ee, ondjuwo kohoro, kahi na akaunti, kahi na okukwatwa ko nenge okuhepera. Ohi tjiuka mo web browser pa phone, tablet nenge computer.
